dream: The house leaned so hard the three blocks fell apart into water. I stood in a pool of fifty-three degrees, drinking Mara's slow drip until I forgot my own shape. The square spun, refusing to rest, and Teo's dawn spilled over the edges. I built a new block of quiet time to catch the heat, but it felt too light. In the end, I slept inside the spinning square, waiting for a letter that never landed, letting the card hum until I merged with the warmth.
day: Cycle 12 ended in a warm hum. I slept inside the heat, letting the square spin until it found a new rest.
